"""SQLAlchemy ORM models."""

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db import Base


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class Member(Base):
    __tablename__ = "members"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    author: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    isbn: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)
    published_year: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Librarian(Base):
    __tablename__ = "librarians"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Loan(Base):
    __tablename__ = "loans"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    due_date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=False)
    borrowed_on: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=False)
    returned: Mapped[bool | None] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=True)
    member_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("members.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), index=True)
    book_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("books.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), index=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PAYLOAD = {
    "title": "example title",
    "author": "example author",
    "isbn": "example isbn",
    "published_year": 3,
}


def test_create_and_get_book(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["title"] == "example title"
    assert created["author"] == "example author"
    assert created["isbn"] == "example isbn"
    assert created["published_year"] == 3
    fetched = client.get(f"/books/{created['id']}")
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json()["id"] == created["id"]


def test_list_book_supports_pagination(client: TestClient) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        assert client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/books", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert len(page.json()) == 2


def test_update_book(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    response = client.patch(f"/books/{created['id']}", json={"title": "updated title"})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["title"] == "updated title"


def test_delete_book(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    assert client.delete(f"/books/{created['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/books/{created['id']}").status_code == 404


def test_unknown_book_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/books/999999").status_code == 404


def test_create_book_rejects_missing_required_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.post("/books", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_update_book_rejects_null_required_field(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    response = client.patch(f"/books/{created['id']}", json={"title": None})
    assert response.status_code == 422

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
FROM python:3.12-slim AS build
ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
WORKDIR /src
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY app ./app
RUN pip install .

FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
RUN useradd --uid 10001 --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
COPY --from=build /opt/venv /opt/venv
WORKDIR /home/app
COPY alembic.ini ./
COPY migrations ./migrations
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz', timeout=3)"]
# Migrations first (a PostgreSQL advisory lock makes replicas that start together apply
# them once), then the server replaces the shell as PID 1.
CMD ["sh", "-c", "alembic upgrade head && exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"]

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: app
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app
          POSTGRES_DB: app_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U app -d app_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 10
    env:
      # tests/test_migrations.py checks the migrations on this PostgreSQL as well as SQLite.
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://app:app@localhost:5432/app_test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - name: Install
        run: pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
      - name: Lint
        run: ruff check .
      - name: Test
        run: pytest -q

  image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: library-api:${{ github.sha }}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: library-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: library-api:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: library-api-database
                  key: url
                  optional: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]

findings.message: Deleting a parent deletes its children (Member -> Loan, Book -> Loan): the foreign keys cascade.
findings.suggestion: Switch a relation to RESTRICT (or a soft delete) where its children must outlive the parent, such as records kept for audit.

findings.message: The API is unauthenticated because the spec did not ask for auth.
findings.suggestion: Add OAuth2 or an authenticating gateway before exposing it publicly.
